findings.title: Touch on the wand while a pen stroke is in progress starts the wand and cuts the stroke
findings.trigger: Pen pointerdown and moves on the parchment; while pen is down, non-primary touch pointerdown on .voice-wand; continue pen moves; pen up.
findings.expected: Stroke continues unbroken; wand remains idle while a palm rests on it during inking.
findings.actual: main gets phase-connecting, wand aria-label 'Connecting… keep holding', canvas pixel at 55% width stays 255 (no ink) although pen kept moving. Pixel at 30% is 41 (inked before the palm).
findings.causality: Parchment filters pointer types and honours a locked gate in SketchCanvas.tsx:191-199. grep for pointerType in web/src matches only SketchCanvas.tsx, so the wand button accepts touch pointerdown with no pen-in-contact check. The exact wand line that locks the canvas was not read in this pass.
findings.why_tests_miss: desk.e2e.ts 'palm input ignored' places the palm on the parchment only, never on a frame control during an active stroke.
findings.smallest_fix: In the wand pointerdown handler, return early when a pen pointer is currently in contact on the parchment (expose SketchCanvas pointer.current as a data attribute on main), or when e.pointerType === 'touch' && !e.isPrimary. Keep finger taps working when no pen is down.
findings.oracle: palm-wand.review.ts:71 pixel at 55% < 100; wand aria-label not matching /Connecting/ while pen is down; after pen lift a real wand tap still reaches phase-connecting.
findings.limits: Synthetic PointerEvents in headless Chromium with setPointerCapture stubbed. DC-1 driver-level palm rejection not tested.

findings.title: When localStorage is full, warned ink is lost on reload and the archive current pair reverts to the stale sketch
findings.trigger: Fill localStorage to near quota; draw one more stroke; wait past the archive debounce; reload.
findings.expected: No silent loss: post-quota ink survives reload or the archived copy keeps the newer sketch.
findings.actual: Stroke visible (pixel 41), draft key unchanged, room message shown. After reload: 1 stroke, pixel 255. Archive current pair equals the pre-quota PNG, not the post-quota PNG.
findings.causality: changed() at SketchCanvas.tsx:79-92 catches the setItem failure, reports the message, and continues; strokes live only in memory. On mount (93-98) the stale localStorage draft replaces memory and the archive is re-sealed from it. archive.ts was not re-read in this pass; the overwrite is observed, the exact line is not cited.
findings.why_tests_miss: archive.e2e.ts 'archive failure cannot clear the sketch' fails the archive, not the draft save, and does not reload afterwards.
findings.smallest_fix: In the catch branch set draftDirty and write the drawing to the IndexedDB store under a draft key; on mount prefer the IndexedDB draft when newer; do not re-seal the archive current pair from a localStorage draft while draftDirty is set.
findings.limits: Quota forced with filler keys in Chromium; real quota differs per tablet browser.

findings.title: Draft strokes serialise at about 57 bytes per point at full double precision; whole drawing rewritten per stroke
findings.expected: Compact draft so hours of sketches stay well inside quota.
findings.actual: 11429 bytes for 201 points; about 92k points fit 5 MiB (roughly six minutes of continuous 240 Hz ink).
findings.causality: Points stored as {x,y,p} doubles with JSON.stringify of the full array on every change.
findings.smallest_fix: Round x, y, p to 4 decimals when serialising.
findings.limits: Realistic sketches are far smaller; this mainly shortens the road to F2.
